title: Reading at the copying frontier
statement: For Boolean words $p$ and $r$, the tape that is blank on the first $|p|$ cells and otherwise stores their concatenation reads at cell $|p|$ the first symbol of $r$, or blank if $r$ is empty.
replaced:
For all Boolean words $p$ and $r$, the partially cleared copying tape with processed
prefix $p$ and suffix $r$ reads, at cell $|p|$, the first bit of $r$, or blank when $r$
is empty.
